scope: Pinned local workspace validation and complete cross-platform CI for the trusted research MVP implementation.
command_note: The local runner used the absolute path to rustup-managed Cargo 1.97.1. Commands below use its equivalent portable rustup form.
timing_note: Build times are Cargo-reported wall times. Test times sum Rust harness batch times and exclude executable startup and command overhead; these are separate measurements, not throughput guarantees.
source_note: The release build/execution began with the frozen source that was then committed as this source_commit. Test-profile execution began after that commit. No production or test source changed during either execution.

test.build_command: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo +1.97.1 test -p naome-validator -p naome-verifier --profile test --all-targets --all-features --locked --no-run
test.execution_command: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo +1.97.1 test -p naome-validator -p naome-verifier --profile test --all-targets --all-features --locked proof_sync --no-fail-fast

release.build_command: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo +1.97.1 test -p naome-validator -p naome-verifier --profile release --all-targets --all-features --locked --no-run
release.execution_command: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo +1.97.1 test -p naome-validator -p naome-verifier --profile release --all-targets --all-features --locked proof_sync --no-fail-fast

focused_intake.execution_command: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo +1.97.1 test -p naome-validator -p naome-verifier --profile release --all-targets --all-features --locked network_intake_100_heights_with_competing_full_offers_and_partition_healing --no-fail-fast
focused_intake.source_note: Production and intake diagnostics match source_commit. A later test-only correction affected the separate proof-sync fallback helper.
